releaseBoundary: This is a manually pinned primary-source security baseline. It is not a live updater. Refresh checkedAt, versions, securityFixCount and reference on the day of every public Direct release. A zero securityFixCount means the official Stable post did not enumerate security fixes; it never means that the version is exempt from the minimum-version gate.
policy: New public NeAntik Direct builds must meet the latest widely deployed macOS Desktop Stable security baseline. The official October 6 update lists 155.0.8059.39/.40 and 247 security fixes. The October 7 M156 Early Stable announcement concerns a limited rollout and is tracked separately; refresh this baseline on the day of publication. Historical source provenance binds archived baseline bytes independently of this current publication gate.
